change.behavior: When st_dev differs across mount namespaces, accept the recorded inode only if the workspace still resides on the private session-root filesystem and its exact ownership marker matches. Replaced inodes, foreign filesystems, symlinks, and changed markers remain preserved.

observed_resource.recovery: The canonical mncs-env scratch --clean operation released the exact registered directory after the patched identity and owner-marker checks passed.

related_service_issue: Control MCP completion initially could not open the Environment scratch lock because its read-write systemd allowlist includes the Environment store but not the sibling scratch directory. The exact cleanup was recovered through the supported Environment CLI; a separate Control Work Intent is needed to correct the service sandbox.
